Question B-001-022-001.

Why the correct answer is right: The NOT-correct statement is the claim of a five-dollar ISED office fee; ISED office qualification examinations are no charge in the current bank.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "An accredited examiner may recover the cost of administering an examination": Accredited-examiner cost recovery is allowed, so this true statement is not the exception.
- sourceIndex 2: "An accredited examiner must hold an Amateur Radio Operator Certificate with Basic, Advanced, and Morse code qualifications": Those three qualifications are the examiner-qualification requirement taught for this subsection.
- sourceIndex 3: "There are no fees for taking an examination for an Amateur Radio Operator Certificate at an Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada office": This states the no-charge ISED office rule, so it is the opposite of the false five-dollar claim.
